description: Splits a microtonal pitch into the nearest semitone and the deviation from it, so a VST host that takes only quantized pitches can be bent onto the microtonal note

inputs.text: The pitch from a quantizer, microtonal scales included

outputs.text: The incoming pitch rounded to the standard grid of 0.083V per semitone, to be sent to the host as its pitch CV
The amount the incoming pitch differs from that semitone, scaled for a host whose pitch bend is set to plus and minus 12 semitones
The amount the incoming pitch differs from that semitone, scaled for a host whose pitch bend is set to plus and minus 1 semitone

notes: the module has no controls at all: patch a quantizer into its input and send its two outputs to the host, one as the pitch and one as the pitch bend
set the host's bend range to match whichever of the two bend outputs you use
no Scala file or scale is loaded here; the microtonal scale comes from whatever quantizer feeds the input.
